abort.already_configured: This Weekey account is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach s.weekey.cn. Check the network and try again.
error.invalid_session: That PHPSESSID was not accepted (server replied not logged in). Capture a fresh one.

data_description.phpsessid: Session cookie value copied from a packet capture or DevTools. This is the only credential. A full "Cookie: PHPSESSID=xxx" line is accepted.

user.description: Weekey has no public login endpoint, so paste the PHPSESSID from the mini program session. The community is resolved from the session itself.

reauth_confirm.description: The Weekey session expired. Capture a fresh PHPSESSID from the mini program and paste it here.
